real: Russia devalues the rouble and defaults on its debt
anon: A large country stops paying its debts
note: Joint government and central bank statement of 17 Aug (Monday). CRS report is a secondary official summary; a checker may prefer the Bank of Russia text. Index closed up that day.

real: Russia's parliament rejects Yeltsin's choice for PM
anon: Political turmoil deepens in a country in crisis
note: Duma rejected Chernomyrdin on 31 Aug (first of two rejections; Yeltsin then dropped him). Source is secondary; checker to confirm date against a primary record. Index fell sharply that day (largest fall in the file).

real: After Friday's close, Greenspan says US is no oasis
anon: After the close, the central bank chief warns of risk
note: Speech at UC Berkeley on the evening of Fri 4 Sep, after the close; Mon 7 Sep was Labor Day, so it goes on Tue 8 Sep. Line paraphrases 'not credible that the United States can remain an oasis of prosperity'.

real: Clinton calls for US leadership on the global crisis
anon: The president urges the nation to lead on the crisis
note: Remarks to the Council on Foreign Relations, New York, 14 Sep.

real: After Wednesday's close, 14 banks rescue LTCM
anon: After the close, lenders save a troubled firm
note: Rescue ($3.6bn from 14 banks and brokers) was agreed on the evening of Wed 23 Sep after the close, so it goes on Thu 24 Sep. Index fell on the 24th, so no market-move claim.

real: Fed cuts its key interest rate to about 5.25%
anon: The central bank cuts borrowing costs a little
note: FOMC cut federal funds target by a quarter point to about 5 1/4 percent, 29 Sep.

real: Fed's McDonough tells Congress why LTCM was rescued
anon: A top banker tells lawmakers why a rescue was needed
note: New York Fed president William McDonough to House Banking Committee, 1 Oct.

real: Over the weekend, G7 finance chiefs meet on the crisis
anon: Over the weekend top finance chiefs meet on the crisis
note: G7 finance ministers and central bank governors met Sat 3 Oct in Washington; goes on Mon 5 Oct. Host is the G7 Research Group archive of the official statement.

real: Fed cuts interest rates again, between meetings
anon: The central bank makes a surprise cut to borrowing costs
note: Unscheduled cut: discount rate to 4.75%, funds rate expected to about 5%. Index rose strongly that day (largest rise in the file after 8 Sep).

real: Fed cuts its key interest rate to about 4.75%
anon: The central bank cuts borrowing costs once more
note: Third cut in the series; funds rate expected to about 4.75%, discount rate 4.5%. Falls after the fall window (recovery row).
